t: This is a terrace of houses from the 1820s in Regent's Park, along the Outer Circle and York Terrace East. It was designed by John Nash, the Georgian and Regency architect responsible for many important parts of London, working in the neoclassical and picturesque styles. Nash's work was financed by the Prince Regent and by the property developer James Burton, and he collaborated extensively with Burton's son, Decimus Burton. It is one of the terraces that make up the Regent's Park scheme.
